description: Hand-written negative + ambiguity probes for the routing eval. Neutral content only (no names from any private library). expected=NO_MATCH: out-of-domain briefs the router must abstain on. expected=AMBIGUOUS: briefs deliberately spanning 2+ plausible domains where a confident single dispatch would be wrong.
